claims.text: Coder's audit logging is available only on the paid Premium tier.
Coder's multi-organization access control is a paid Premium feature.
Coder positions as enterprise dev-environment infrastructure for platform teams.
Coder Agents (self-hosted, model-agnostic AI coding agents) launched in May 2026.
Daytona runs a managed control plane; sandbox compute executes on customer-managed compute in the customer's own cloud (a BYOC data plane). Usage-billed.

Daytona's AGPL-3.0 stack (dashboard/runner/SDKs) is public and self-hostable but FROZEN — core dev moved to a private codebase June 2026 (no further updates/fixes/releases, per the daytonaio/daytona README). The live product is a managed control plane + BYOC compute. (Resolved by a3 2026-06-30.)
E2B's Pro tier is about $150/month plus usage.
E2B can be self-hosted DIY in your own cloud from the open-source repo (not enterprise-gated); the default product is the managed cloud. Enterprise adds BYOC/on-prem with support.
The Claude Managed Agents orchestration / agent loop runs on Anthropic's servers.
The Claude Managed Agents execution sandbox can be self-hosted in your own VPC.
Claude Managed Agents runs Claude only (single vendor).

claims.text: Rivet is Apache-2.0 open source and self-hostable.
Rivet is a developer primitive (composable building blocks), not a finished run-it product.
Rivet's sandbox-agent is a universal API that drives several agent CLIs on top of other sandbox providers.
